headline: Two firefighting crew die in Greek helicopter collision
summary: A Danish pilot and Greek coordinator died near Psatha west of Athens; a British pilot and another Greek crew member survived.
script: Two crew members died after firefighting helicopters collided near Psatha, west of Athens. AP says the victims were a Danish pilot and a Greek coordinator. A British pilot and another Greek crew member survived.
